description: This file manages ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R interrupt handling, including enabling/disabling interrupts, setting priorities, handling spurious interrupts, and dynamic ISR connection for Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: arch_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ via GIC if custom controller is not used.

methods.name: arch_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific IRQ via GIC if custom controller is not used.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled via GIC.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_irq_spurious
methods.description: Handles spurious interrupts by triggering a fatal error.

methods.name: arch_irq_connect_dynamic
methods.description: Connects a dynamic interrupt service routine at runtime.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_direct_dynamic_dispatch_reschedule
methods.description: Dispatches a dynamic IRQ and requests rescheduling.

methods.name: z_arm_irq_direct_dynamic_dispatch_no_reschedule
methods.description: Dispatches a dynamic IRQ without rescheduling.
